tests.name: y-combinator-1
tests.program:
let fix =  proc (f)
            let d = proc (x) proc (z) ((f (x x)) z)
            in proc (n) ((f (d d)) n)
in let
    t4m = proc (f) proc(x) if zero?(x) then 0 else -((f -(x,1)),-4)
in let times4 = (fix t4m)
   in (times4 3)

tests.name: HO-nested-letrecs
tests.program:
letrec even(odd)  = proc(x) if zero?(x) then 1 else (odd -(x,1))
   in letrec  odd(x)  = if zero?(x) then 0 else ((even odd) -(x,1))
   in (odd 13)

tests.name: gensym-test
even-odd-via-set
tests.program:
let x = 0
in letrec even(d) = if zero?(x) then 1 
                                  else let d = set x = -(x,1)
                                       in (odd d)
              odd(d)  = if zero?(x) then 0 
                                  else let d = set x = -(x,1)
                                       in (even d)
   in let d = set x = 13 in (odd -99)

tests.name: gensym-using-mutable-pair-left
tests.program:
let g = let count = newpair(0,0) 
         in proc (dummy) 
              begin
               setleft count = -(left(count), -1);
               left(count)
              end
in -((g 22), (g 22))
